rationale: Evaluating prevention of unintended braking requires characterising whether the vehicle brakes and whether that braking is justified in the declared situation. H-3 establishes sudden stopping without an obstacle as the hazardous event, SG-3 directly targets unintended braking, and FR-7 establishes obstacle-collision avoidance as an intended braking purpose. Braking behaviour therefore belongs to the phenomenon itself. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or mechanism timing.
determining_elements: “Vehicle braking behavior” and “whether braking occurs” directly address the behaviour targeted by SG-3 and H-3.
“Whether it is justified by an obstacle or collision-avoidance need” captures the relationship supported by H-3 and FR-7 for evaluating unintended braking.
The declared scope matches H-3: straight-ahead urban driving at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead.
